title: Mrs. John Moore, 81, Dies at Savoy Home
text:
Mrs. John Moore, 81, Dies at Savoy Home

SAVOY — Funeral services for Mrs. John Moore, 81, who died Thursday morning at her home here, were to be held at 3 p.m. Friday in Savoy Methodist Church. Burial was to be in Rose Hill Cemetery, Bells.

Mrs. Moore had been ill six months. She moved to Savoy from Bells 10 years ago.

A native of Lynville, Tenn., Mrs. Moore was Miss Kate Matthews before her marriage in Bells Dec. 31, 1873. She was a member of Savoy Methodist Church.

Surviving are twin sons, C. H. Moore of Savoy and Clarence Moore of Denison; two daughters, Mrs. Grady Stone of Bells and Mrs. T. L. Beckham of Savoy; a sister, Mrs. Ethel Webber of Austin; 10 grandchildren and seven great grandchildren.
